subject: general
question: Which DRDO lab conducted a successful laser weapon test in April 2025?

options.text: CHESS (Centre for High Energy Systems and Sciences)

solution:
The correct answer is __**CHESS (Centre for High Energy Systems and Sciences)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **CHESS (Centre for High Energy Systems and Sciences)** is a premier DRDO lab responsible for research in high-energy systems, including advanced laser systems.
 
• In April 2025, CHESS successfully conducted a test of a laser weapon, marking a significant advancement in India's directed energy weapon (DEW) capabilities.
 
• This laser weapon test is part of India's efforts to develop indigenous DEWs for use in air defense, counter-drone systems, and other strategic applications.
 
• CHESS has been working on developing laser systems capable of targeting and neutralizing threats with high precision and minimal collateral damage.
 
• The success of this test showcases India's growing capabilities in futuristic defense technologies, aligning with the "Atmanirbhar Bharat" (self-reliant India) initiative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Directed Energy Weapons (DEWs):**

 
 
• DEWs use focused energy in the form of lasers, microwaves, or particle beams to damage or neutralize enemy targets.
 
• They provide advantages such as precision targeting, reduced collateral damage, and cost-effectiveness compared to traditional munitions.
 
• DEWs can be used for applications such as missile defense, counter-drone systems, and disabling electronic systems.
 
 
 
• **DRDO (Defence Research and Development Organisation):**
 
 
• DRDO is India's premier defense R&D agency, under the Ministry of Defence, established in 1958.
 
• It is tasked with developing cutting-edge technologies for the Indian Armed Forces.
 
• DRDO's research spans multiple domains, including missiles, radars, electronic warfare, and advanced weapon systems.
 
 
 
• **CHESS (Centre for High Energy Systems and Sciences):**
 
 
• Located in Hyderabad, CHESS is a DRDO lab specializing in high-energy systems and directed energy weapons.
 
• It collaborates with other DRDO labs and academic institutions to develop advanced technologies for the Indian military.
 
 
 
• **India's Laser Weapon Program:**
 
 
• India has been investing in laser weapons for applications such as missile defense, counter-drone operations, and air defense.
 
• CHESS and other DRDO labs are actively working on developing high-power lasers to address emerging security threats.
